notes.title: Now Available on Steam - LogoMaker 4, 20% off!
notes.content:
LogoMaker 4 is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off*!

LogoMaker lets you create a professional quality logo, advertisement or website header in minutes. No previous experience is necessary, as LogoMaker puts powerful design tools at your fingertips. Easy to use features include over 3,300 fully modifiable logo templates, 10,000+ customizable objects, and creative tools and special effects.
